themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: EasyJet's take-private is still a two-bidder contest between Castlelake (ezj-castlelake-takeover) and Apollo (ezj-apollo-takeover), ITV sold its broadcast arm to Comcast's Sky (itv-sky-me-sale), Prologis's 'best and final' bid for Segro has the board minded to recommend with the PUSU deadline extended to Aug 12 (pld-sgro-takeover-bid), and OCS Group's agreed GBP3.1bn takeover of Mitie will remove another UK name from the LSE entirely (ocs-mitie-acquisition).

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: PE- and shareholder-led buyouts keep pulling listed names private: EasyJet's take-private is a live Castlelake vs Apollo bidding war (ezj-castlelake-takeover, ezj-apollo-takeover), Steel Partners is bidding $16.75/share for InMode (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), EQT/Advent/KKR are circling Qiagen (qgen-pe-consortium-takeover-interest), Vista Equity Partners and Quinti Capital have approached Criteo (crto-vista-quinti-takeover-interest), Perfect Corp.'s founder took the company private (perf-projectny-going-private), Perpetual's board has rejected three EQT approaches but the situation remains unsettled (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid), Frasers Group's shareholder-led tender for Hugo Boss runs to July 27 at a final EUR38/share (boss-frasers-takeover-offer), Stripe and Advent's joint $53bn+ offer for PayPal remains live after board rejection (pypl-stripe-advent-takeover-bid), and OCS Group's CD&R-backed takeover of Mitie adds a new PE-driven UK delisting (ocs-mitie-acquisition).

themes.label: Defense primes racing for undersea/anti-submarine-warfare tech
themes.note: Defense primes keep building out undersea-warfare capability: Thales's control deal for mine-clearing drone maker Exail (ho-exail-acquisition), Lockheed's $3.45bn purchase of sonar specialist Ultra Maritime (lmt-ultra-maritime-acquisition), and Fincantieri bundling four acquisitions into an underwater-tech champion (fct-underwater-champion-acquisitions).

themes.label: AI data-center capacity and power build-out
themes.note: Capital and commercial partnerships keep pouring into the physical layer of AI compute: TeraWulf's 20-year, ~$19bn AI data-center lease with Anthropic (wulf-anthropic-lease), Meta's expansion of its Louisiana campus to 5GW and $50bn+ (meta-richland-parish-capex), Williams's $5.34bn Blackstone-led JV to fund five behind-the-meter data-center power projects (wmb-blackstone-power-jv), 3M and Microsoft's partnership to deploy 3M's optical technology across Azure's AI data centers (mmm-msft-ai-datacenter-partnership), Microsoft's commitment to deploy AMD's Helios AI systems at scale on Azure (msft-amd-helios-partnership), AMD's up-to-$5bn equity bet on Anthropic tied to a 2GW MI450 chip deployment (amd-anthropic-chip-partnership), NVIDIA's $1.5bn prepaid packaging-capacity deal with Amkor (amkr-nvidia-packaging-partnership), Verizon's $1bn dark-fiber supply deal with Google (vz-google-fiber-partnership), Alphabet's 2026 capex guide raised to as much as $205bn on AI demand (googl-capex-raise-2026), Samsung Electronics's ~$200bn HBM memory and foundry MOU with Broadcom (samsungelec-avgo-chip-partnership), and SK hynix's long-term HBM supply pact with NVIDIA tied to a 2GW Vera Rubin AI factory (skhynix-nvda-ai-partnership).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep drawing legal fire: the already-signed, DOJ-cleared Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger is now formally paused by court stipulation until five days after an antitrust trial or June 1, 2027 -- with Paramount now on the hook for ~$7m/day if the pause runs past September 30, 2026 -- after suits from a 12-state AG coalition and the Writers Guild of America (psky-wbd-acquisition), while InMode's Special Committee remains procedurally frozen pending the Israeli court's ruling on competing buyout bids (inmd-steel-partners-buyout).
